meta.name: gamepad-support-for-linux-mindustry-mod
meta.author: NTT
meta.description:
[accent]Native Linux controller support[] via [lightgray]/dev/input/js*[].
Works out of the box with DualSense, DualShock 4, and Xbox controllers without external native libraries.

[accent]Features:[]
• [white]3 Gameplay Modes:[] Normal (L2), Build (R1), and Command (L1)
• [white]Smart Building:[] Line placement, area deconstruct, block pipette, and area copy/paste
• [white]Inventory Inspector:[] Deposit items (hold X) or inspect & take resources from buildings (hold O)
• [white]Full RTS Control:[] Box unit selection, target assignment, and command/stance cycling
• [white]UI & Menu Navigation:[] Virtual cursor with click & drag support
